chunks: Until Allah sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), a witness, a giver of good tidings and a warner, the best of creation as a child, and the most chaste as a grown man, the purest of the purified in character, and the most generous of those approached for generosity.
ai.seo_question: What are the key virtues and titles attributed to Prophet Muhammad in this eulogy from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi employs classical Arabic rhetorical devices to portray the Prophet’s transition from innate childhood virtue to mature adult excellence, framing him as the pinnacle of creation. This eulogy underscores the theological concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and moral perfection, which serves as the foundational justification for the subsequent discussion on the Umayyads and the necessity of Imamate. The description aligns with the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet’s character as the ultimate model for spiritual and ethical guidance.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Then Allāh deputed Muḥammad (S) as a witness, giver of good tidings and warner, the best in the universe as a child and the chastest as a grown up man, the purest of the purified in conduct, the most generous of those who are approached for generosity.
